title: A Bridge for the Letter
author: Emrys Sandoval
blurb: Wren Eastwick, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, has spent three years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
